name: Handle Size Measurement via Nonseparating Cuts
aliases: Reeb loop and cross loop measurement
definition: A method to measure handle size by computing two nonseparating cuts: the Reeb loop (nearly shortest loop around the Reeb cycle) and the cross loop (nearly shortest loop transversal to the Reeb loop). The handle size is defined as the smaller of the two loop lengths.
summary: Handle Size Measurement via Nonseparating Cuts quantifies topological handles by explicitly constructing minimal Reeb and cross loops on the isosurface, unlike methods relying solely on multi-dimensional descriptors.
